description: This file serves as the main webpage interface for a database visualization application. It includes HTML markup, CSS styling, and JavaScript code to load database data, display tables, and allow user interactions like refreshing and expanding data cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the database list by fetching data again and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables within the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders the data from a selected table, limiting to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML for displaying table data in a scrollable, styled table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data type, including support for long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content to show full text or structured data.
